payload.purpose_context: The docs/context section (40 published pages) defines the readers, terms and concepts every other doc section writes to, but many pages are stale, name no reader and still mention surfaces removed from open-core. This mission refreshes the section for issue #7522 (epic #3891): audience profiles first, then the glossary-footgun and concept pages, then the rest, verifying each claim against the code and draining the section's retired-surface burn-down.
payload.purpose_tldr: Check every docs/context page against the current CLI and code, name its reader, and rewrite it to the writing guidance, starting with the audience profiles.

payload.final_answer: gap_filling: docs/context already exists (40 published pages); the #7520 audit lists what each page lacks (reader, freshness, retired surfaces, text diagrams). Source: #7522 Scope, #3891 Approach step 2.

The 40 published pages under docs/context/ listed in the #7522 audit comment (13 audience pages incl. 3 hub READMEs, then the concept pages). Immutable history (ADRs, plans/, reports/, changelog/, archive/), packs/ and the bot-generated docs-retrieval-index.yaml / page-inventory.yaml are out of scope. Source: #7522 Scope, #3891 Approach step 4, operator brief.

payload.question: In what order is the section refreshed?

payload.final_answer: Audience profiles first (docs/context/audience/**), then orchestration/execution/topology/team-kitty, then the remaining context pages; WP02 and WP03 depend on WP01. Source: #7522 Order, operator brief.

payload.question: May the mission add or remove an audience profile?

payload.final_answer: No. The ten profiles stay; any add/remove is brought to the operator as a proposal. Source: #7522 Order step 1, operator brief.

payload.question: Who writes and how are facts handled?

payload.final_answer: comms-cleo writes; every claim, command, flag and path is checked against the current CLI (--help) and source; unverifiable facts are flagged to the operator, never invented or dropped; corrections are recorded with evidence. Source: #3891 'Who does the writing', operator brief.
